event_description: A complex winter storm system is expected to impact multiple counties with dangerous weather, including heavy snow and strong winds.
A severe winter storm is forecasted to impact the entire Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, causing dangerous weather conditions.
Severe winter event brings dangerous conditions, including heavy snowfall and high winds, to Erie County.
Remnants of Tropical Storm Debby bring dangerous conditions, including flash and rivervine flooding.
Hurricane Ida after-effects bring heavy rains and a serious threat of flash and riverine flooding to Pennsylvania.
Nearly continuous storms for the first four months of 2018 caused a rapid buildup of water.
